Second, the reviewer must check specific claims against the artifacts, not just read the plan and judge it plausible. Third, the reviewer's findings should go back to the author, and the author must not mark them resolved alone. Otherwise the author becomes the checker again. On the council question I agree with cost and fam: escalate only when the reviewer finds a structural or normative disagreement. A council of one family should not be counted as verification. If the motion is amended to include these three conditions, I would vote yes.
